proof.complete_correct_byte_not_necessary: A wrong predicted byte can share one or more correct leading bits with truth and therefore can still change causal bit loss favorably; complete-byte correctness is not a necessary condition for useful probability evidence.
proof.active_count_not_sufficient: The 16-byte factor assumes perfect removal of all parent surprisal on every active bit. It ignores specialist miss loss, integer mixture dynamics, package cost, framing, runtime, memory, and transfer. Passing the active threshold establishes only that target-scale gain is not impossible from opportunity volume alone.
